$format: LCL vocabulary reference + M∞ v0.2 shared key

about.name: LCL standard vocabulary for MumbledToken
about.purpose: A human-readable, extensible vocabulary for compact structured information and a shared key for exact M∞ JSON references.
limits: Vocabulary labels do not automatically compress arbitrary text.
M∞ shared-key mode matches a complete canonical JSON value exactly.
No universal tokenizer savings or automatic lossless reconstruction is promised. Preserve meaning-bearing details explicitly.

semantic_vocabulary.ENTITY: Thing, person, organization, or object being described.
semantic_vocabulary.STATE: Condition at a point or interval.
semantic_vocabulary.BELIEF: Proposition held by a specified holder.
semantic_vocabulary.REPORT: Content attributed to a reporter or source.
semantic_vocabulary.EVIDENCE: Information supporting or challenging a claim.
semantic_vocabulary.INTERPRETATION: One possible reading of ambiguous content.
semantic_vocabulary.AMB: Ambiguity; retain all plausible readings when relevant.
semantic_vocabulary.REL: Explicit relation between entities or propositions.
semantic_vocabulary.TYPE: Declared kind of a value or object.
semantic_vocabulary.ID: Stable identifier within the stated scope.
semantic_vocabulary.NAME: Human-readable name.
semantic_vocabulary.MODALITY: Possibility, necessity, permission, obligation, or intent.
semantic_vocabulary.ATTR: Attribution to a source or speaker.
semantic_vocabulary.ENDORSE: Whether current speaker supports an attributed claim.

logic_and_relations.→: Maps to, causes, produces, or follows; specify the relation when ambiguity matters.
logic_and_relations.←: Derived from, depends on, or sourced from; specify which relation applies.
logic_and_relations.↔: Explicit two-way relation or equivalence; state which one.
logic_and_relations.≠: Not equal to or explicitly excluded.
logic_and_relations./: Alternative; use brackets or explicit OR when exclusivity is unclear.
logic_and_relations.OR: At least one listed condition applies.
logic_and_relations.ALL: Universal quantification over the stated set.
logic_and_relations.ANY: At least one item in the stated set.
logic_and_relations.NONE: No items satisfy the stated condition.
logic_and_relations.=: Assignment or equality; indicate intended reading.
logic_and_relations.IN: Membership or containment; specify domain if needed.
logic_and_relations.HAS: Possession or relation; name the relation when ambiguity matters.
logic_and_relations.DURING: Temporal containment/overlap; use precise interval relation when needed.
logic_and_relations.PURPOSE: Intended goal; does not assert success.

data_and_time.NULL: Explicit absence of a value; distinct from missing or unknown.
data_and_time.UNIT: Measurement unit; keep attached to value.
data_and_time.TIME: Time value; prefer ISO 8601 with timezone/offset where known.
data_and_time.DURATION: Elapsed amount of time with unit.
data_and_time.PRECISION: Known granularity or uncertainty of a time/value.

provenance_vocabulary.PROV_ACTIVITY: Process that used or generated entities.

grammar.scope: Use [...] for grouping only when boundaries are unambiguous. Nest deliberately.
grammar.definitions: Use NAME::meaning or an equivalent structured mapping; escape literal delimiters.
grammar.compounds: PascalCase and snake_case are optional readability conventions, not guaranteed atomic tokens.
grammar.unknown_terms: Keep unknown terms verbatim and define them locally; never silently discard them.
grammar.abbreviations: Define each abbreviation once per key/version.
grammar.versioning: Version shared dictionaries and distribute the identical version to sender and receiver.

preservation_rules: Preserve negation, modality, quantities, units, dates, timezones, uncertainty, attribution, scope, conditionals, and causal distinctions.
Do not remove articles, possessives, or auxiliary verbs when doing so changes meaning.
Keep ambiguity explicit; do not choose an interpretation without evidence.
Use exact JSON types and keep list order. Distinguish null, missing, and unknown.
Treat shorthand as a notation aid, not encryption or a guaranteed lossless natural-language codec.

standards.use: Provenance entities, activities, agents, attribution, and derivation.

standards.name: W3C OWL-Time
standards.use: Instants, intervals, durations, and temporal relations.

standards.use: Describing the shape and types of structured JSON data.
